title: Parts Repaid When a Lack-of-Maintenance Denial Is Re-decided — Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts
content:
For a maintenance re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the parts repaid follow how the repaired line's parts were billed. The parts are the store's customer-pay parts lines on the concern line carrying the repair order's diagnostic fee, in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

| Parts billing on the repaired line | Parts repaid |
|---|---|
| Charged below list | the parts charged |
| Charged at list, with a goodwill credit given by the store on the repaired line | the list amount less that goodwill credit |
| Charged at list with no goodwill credit | the list amount |

**Hypothetical illustrations.**
- List 903.10, charged 812.79: 812.79 is repaid.
- List 903.10, charged 903.10, goodwill credit 150.00: 753.10 is repaid.
- List 903.10, charged 903.10, no credit: 903.10 is repaid.
